questions.text: संख्याओं 25 तथा 363 के बीच 6 के गुणजों की संख्या है :
questions.text_english: The number of multiples of 6 lying between 25 and 363 is :
questions.solution: The first multiple of 6 greater than 25 is 30, and the last multiple of 6 less than 363 is 360. The multiples of 6 form an AP: 30, 36, 42, ..., 360. Number of terms = (360 - 30)/6 + 1 = 330/6 + 1 = 55 + 1 = 56. However, since the question asks for multiples lying between 25 and 363 (not strictly between, but in the range), counting from 30 to 360 gives 56 terms. But if we check: 6×5 = 30 and 6×60 = 360, so terms are from n=5 to n=60, giving 60 - 5 + 1 = 56 terms. Wait — let us recount using the standard interpretation: multiples of 6 strictly between 25 and 363. First: 30 (=6×5), Last: 360 (=6×60). Count = 60 - 5 + 1 = 56. The answer appears to be 56 (option A), but the standard CBSE answer key marks (C) 57 when the endpoints 25 and 363 themselves are considered part of "between" in the Hindi phrasing implying inclusive — rechecking: if we include 363÷6 = 60.5 so 363 is not a multiple, and 25÷6 ≈ 4.16 so 25 is not a multiple. Multiples: 6×5=30 to 6×60=360, count = 56. The correct answer is (A) 56. Option B is 56.5 which is not an integer and impossible. Option C (57) and D (58) are incorrect. The answer is (A) 56.

questions.text: दो पासे एक साथ फेंके जाते हैं । प्राप्त संख्याओं का योगफल 6 से भाज्य होने की प्रायिकता है :
questions.text_english: Two dice are rolled together. The probability that the sum of the numbers obtained is divisible by 6, is :
questions.solution: When two dice are rolled, the total number of outcomes is 36. The sums divisible by 6 are 6 and 12. Pairs giving sum 6: (1,5), (2,4), (3,3), (4,2), (5,1) — that is 5 pairs. Pairs giving sum 12: (6,6) — that is 1 pair. Total favourable outcomes = 5 + 1 = 6. Therefore, probability = 6/36 = 1/6. Option (A) is correct. Option B (11/36) would correspond to sum divisible by 3 partially; option C (1/12) = 3/36 is too small; option D (1/4) = 9/36 is also incorrect.

questions.text: दी गई आकृति में, △ ABC एक समबाहु त्रिभुज है । बिंदुओं A(0, 5√3/2) तथा D(0, 0) को जोड़ने वाली माध्यिका AD है । बिंदु B तथा C के निर्देशांक (इसी क्रम में) हैं :
questions.text_english: In the given figure, △ ABC is an equilateral triangle. AD is a median of the triangle joining the points A(0, 5√3/2), D(0, 0). Points B and C are (in same order) :
questions.image_description: Equilateral triangle ABC with vertex A at (0, 5√3/2), median AD drawn to D(0,0) on base BC. B is to the left and C is to the right on the x-axis.
questions.solution: In an equilateral triangle, the median is also the altitude. The height AD = 5√3/2. For an equilateral triangle with height h, the side length a satisfies h = (√3/2)a, so a = 2h/√3 = 2×(5√3/2)/√3 = 5. The base BC has length 5, and D is its midpoint at (0,0). Therefore B = (-5/2, 0) and C = (5/2, 0)... but wait: if side = 5, then half-base = 5/2. Let us verify: height = (√3/2)×5 = 5√3/2 ✓. So B = (-5/2, 0) and C = (5/2, 0), which is option (B). However, if we re-examine: the median from A to D where D is the midpoint of BC. AD = 5√3/2. For equilateral triangle, median = (√3/2)×side, so side = 2×(5√3/2)/√3 = 5. Half of base = 5/2. B = (-5/2, 0), C = (5/2, 0). The correct answer is (B).

questions.text: एक बंटन के माध्यक तथा बहुलक क्रमशः 25.2 तथा 26.1 हैं । इस बंटन का माध्य है :
questions.text_english: The median and mode of a distribution are 25.2 and 26.1 respectively. The mean of the distribution is :
questions.solution: Using the empirical relationship: Mode = 3 × Median − 2 × Mean. Substituting the given values: 26.1 = 3 × 25.2 − 2 × Mean. So 26.1 = 75.6 − 2 × Mean. Therefore 2 × Mean = 75.6 − 26.1 = 49.5. Hence Mean = 49.5/2 = 24.75. Option (A) 24.75 is correct. Option B (24.25), C (24.3), and D (25.5) do not satisfy the empirical formula.
questions.topic: Empirical relationship between mean, median and mode

questions.text: दिया गया है कि △ ABC ~ △ QRP है जहाँ AB = 9 cm, BC = 5 cm तथा PR = 2 cm है । भुजा QR की लम्बाई है :
questions.text_english: It is given that △ ABC ~ △ QRP such that AB = 9 cm, BC = 5 cm and PR = 2 cm. Length of side QR is :
questions.solution: Since △ ABC ~ △ QRP, the corresponding sides are proportional: AB/QR = BC/RP = AC/QP. We have AB = 9 cm, BC = 5 cm, PR = RP = 2 cm. Using BC/RP = AB/QR: 5/2 = 9/QR. Therefore QR = 9×2/5 = 18/5 ... but this does not match. Let us use the correct correspondence: AB↔QR, BC↔RP, AC↔QP. So AB/QR = BC/RP gives 9/QR = 5/2, thus QR = 18/5 = 3.6 cm. Wait — that gives option D. However, checking the correspondence again: △ABC ~ △QRP means A↔Q, B↔R, C↔P. So AB↔QR, BC↔RP, CA↔PQ. Thus AB/QR = BC/RP → 9/QR = 5/2 → QR = 18/5 = 3.6 cm. But we also need to check: if AB/QR = AC/QP and AB corresponds to QR... then 9/QR = 5/2 gives QR = 3.6 cm — option D. Alternatively using AB↔QR = 9/QR and PR corresponds to AC (not BC): if BC↔RP then QR = 9×2/5 = 18/5 = 3.6. The correct answer is (C) 10/9 cm only if AB↔QR means AB/QR = BC/RP but with AB/QR=BC/PR differently. Using △ABC~△QRP: AB/QR = BC/RP → QR = AB×RP/BC = 9×2/5 = 18/5 = 3.6. So answer is (D) 3.6 cm.

questions.text: एक ऐसा बहुपद p(x) जिसके शून्यकों का योगफल उनके गुणनफल के बराबर है, है :
questions.text_english: A polynomial p(x), which has sum of its zeroes equal to their product, is :
questions.solution: For a quadratic ax² + bx + c, sum of zeroes = −b/a and product of zeroes = c/a. We need −b/a = c/a, i.e., −b = c. Checking option (A): 3x² + 2x + 2 → sum = −2/3, product = 2/3. Not equal. Option (B): 3x² − 2x − 3 → sum = 2/3, product = −1. Not equal. Option (C): 3x² − 2x + 2 → sum = 2/3, product = 2/3. Equal! But let us verify option (D): x² − 3x + 2 → sum = 3, product = 2. Not equal. Therefore the correct answer is (C) 3x² − 2x + 2, where sum of zeroes = product of zeroes = 2/3.

questions.text: दी गई आकृति में, केन्द्र O तथा 3 cm त्रिज्या वाले वृत्त पर दो स्पर्श रेखाएँ PQ तथा PR खींची गई हैं । यदि ∠QPR = 60° है, तो प्रत्येक स्पर्श रेखा की लम्बाई है :
questions.text_english: In the given figure, PQ and PR are tangents to a circle with centre O and radius 3 cm. If ∠QPR = 60°, then the length of each tangent is :
questions.image_description: Circle with centre O and radius 3 cm. Two tangents PQ and PR drawn from external point P. Angle QPR = 60° is marked at P.
questions.solution: Since OQ ⊥ PQ (radius to tangent), in right triangle OQP: ∠QPR = 60°, so ∠QPO = 30°. We have OQ = 3 cm (radius) and tan(30°) = OQ/PQ. Therefore PQ = OQ/tan(30°) = 3/(1/√3) = 3√3 cm. Option (A) 3√3 cm is correct. Option B (3 cm) would hold if ∠QPO = 45°; option C (6 cm) and D (√3 cm) do not satisfy the trigonometric relationship.

questions.text: दी गई आकृति में OA × OB = OC × OD है । निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा विकल्प सही है ?
questions.text_english: In the given figure, OA × OB = OC × OD. Which of the following option is correct ?
questions.image_description: Two triangles sharing vertex O. Points A and D on one side, C and B on the other, with O as the intersection point. OA×OB = OC×OD is given.
questions.solution: Given OA × OB = OC × OD, we can write OA/OC = OD/OB. Also, ∠AOD = ∠COB (vertically opposite angles). By SAS similarity criterion, △OAD ~ △OCB. This means the correspondence is A↔C, O↔O, D↔B. Therefore △OAD ~ △OBC is correct (option D). Options A, B, and C state angle equalities that do not follow directly from the given condition without the similarity being established first.

questions.text: (1/2 tan² 45° − cos² 60°) का मान है :
questions.text_english: The value of (1/2 tan² 45° − cos² 60°) is :
questions.solution: We know that tan 45° = 1 and cos 60° = 1/2. Substituting: (1/2) × tan² 45° − cos² 60° = (1/2) × 1² − (1/2)² = 1/2 − 1/4 = 1/4. Therefore the answer is (C) 1/4. Option A (0) would require both terms to be equal; option B (−1/2) and D (−1/4) give negative values which is impossible since 1/2 > 1/4.

questions.text: एक ठोस घन में से, जिसके प्रत्येक किनारे की लम्बाई l है, अधिकतम आकार का शंकु खोदकर निकाला जाता है । शंकु का आयतन है :
questions.text_english: A cone of maximum size is carved out from a solid cube of edge length l. The volume of the cone is :
questions.image_description: Solid cube of edge l with a cone carved out from it. The cone fits inside the cube with its base circle inscribed in one face.
questions.solution: The largest cone that can be carved from a cube of edge l has its base as a circle inscribed in one face of the cube. The diameter of this circle equals the edge length l, so radius r = l/2. The height of the cone equals the edge length of the cube, h = l. Volume of cone = (1/3)πr²h = (1/3)π(l/2)²(l) = (1/3)π(l²/4)(l) = πl³/12. Option (A) πl³/12 is correct.
questions.topic: Volume of cone carved from cube

Since 432 = 3 × 144 = 3 × 12² = 3 × 2⁴ × 3² = 2⁴ × 3³, it has more than two factors and is therefore a composite number. Option (A) is wrong — it is not prime. Option (B) is wrong — 432/13 is not an integer. Option (D) is wrong — 432 is even. Option (C) composite number is correct.

questions.text: दिया गया है कि sin 2α = √3/2 है । sin 3α का मान है :
questions.text_english: Given that sin 2α = √3/2, the value of sin 3α is :
questions.solution: sin 2α = √3/2 implies 2α = 60° (taking the principal value), so α = 30°. Therefore sin 3α = sin(3 × 30°) = sin 90° = 1. Option (C) 1 is correct. The other options — (A) 3√3/4, (B) 1/2, and (D) √3/4 — do not equal sin 90°.

questions.text: यदि किसी मीनार की छाया की लम्बाई उसकी ऊँचाई की √3 गुना है, तो सूर्य का उन्नतांश है :
questions.text_english: If the length of the shadow of a tower is √3 times that of its height, then altitude of the Sun is :
questions.solution: Let the height of the tower be h. The shadow length is √3 h. The angle of elevation θ of the Sun satisfies tan θ = height/shadow = h/(√3h) = 1/√3. Therefore θ = 30°. Option (B) 30° is correct. If θ were 45°, tan θ = 1 (shadow = height); if θ were 60°, tan θ = √3 (shadow = h/√3). Option D (15°) is not a standard angle in this context.
questions.topic: Angle of elevation and shadow problems

questions.text: 2.5x − 2y = 3 द्वारा निरूपित रेखा की संपाती रेखा का समीकरण है :
questions.text_english: Equation of a line coincident with 2.5x − 2y = 3 is :
questions.solution: The given line is 2.5x − 2y = 3. Multiplying by 2: 5x − 4y = 6, or 5x − 4y − 6 = 0. A coincident line is a scalar multiple of this. Option (C) 15x − 12y − 3 = 0: dividing by 3 gives 5x − 4y − 1 = 0, which is not a multiple. Let us recheck option (D): 5x − 4y − 6 = 0, i.e., 5x − 4y = 6. The original 2.5x − 2y = 3 multiplied by 2 gives 5x − 4y = 6. So option (D) is coincident. Option (C) 15x − 12y − 3 = 0 → 5x − 4y = 1, which is parallel but not coincident. The correct answer is (D) 5x − 4y − 6 = 0.
questions.chapter: Pair of Linear Equations in Two Variables

questions.text_english: The nth term of the A.P. −1/3, 2/3, 5/3, 8/3, ... is :
questions.solution: The first term a = −1/3 and common difference d = 2/3 − (−1/3) = 3/3 = 1. The nth term aₙ = a + (n−1)d = −1/3 + (n−1)×1 = −1/3 + n − 1 = n − 4/3 = (3n − 4)/3. Let us check option (D): (n−4)/3. For n=1: (1−4)/3 = −3/3 = −1 ≠ −1/3. That is incorrect. Option (C): (n−2)/3. For n=1: (1−2)/3 = −1/3 ✓. For n=2: (2−2)/3 = 0 ≠ 2/3. Not correct. The correct formula is (3n−4)/3. None of the given options exactly matches... but (3n−4)/3 is equivalent to n − 4/3 which is option (B). For n=1: 1 − 4/3 = −1/3 ✓. For n=2: 2 − 4/3 = 2/3 ✓. Option (B) is correct.

questions.text: दी गई आकृति में, केन्द्र O तथा त्रिज्या r वाले वृत्त पर खींची गई स्पर्श रेखा PT है । यदि ∠POT = 45° है, तो OP की लम्बाई है :
questions.text_english: In the given figure, PT is a tangent to the circle with centre O and radius r. If ∠POT = 45°, then the length of OP is :
questions.image_description: Circle with centre O and radius r. Tangent PT drawn from external point P. Angle POT = 45° is marked at O between OP and OT.
questions.solution: Since OT ⊥ PT (radius perpendicular to tangent), triangle OTP is right-angled at T. Given ∠POT = 45°, we use cos(45°) = OT/OP = r/OP. Therefore OP = r/cos(45°) = r/(1/√2) = r√2. Option (A) r√2 is correct. Note that r√2 and √2r are identical; both options A and B appear the same, but the standard notation r√2 is option A.

questions.text: द्विघात समीकरण (x − 1)² = 16 के मूल हैं :
questions.text_english: The roots of the quadratic equation (x − 1)² = 16 are :
questions.solution: (x − 1)² = 16 implies x − 1 = ±4. Taking x − 1 = 4 gives x = 5. Taking x − 1 = −4 gives x = −3. The roots are 5 and −3, which is option (C). Option A (5, 3) is wrong because 3 − 1 = 2, and 2² = 4 ≠ 16. Option B (4, −4): (4−1)² = 9 ≠ 16. Option D (−5, 3): (−5−1)² = 36 ≠ 16.

questions.text: यदि द्विघात समीकरण √3 x² − kx + 2√3 = 0 के मूल वास्तविक तथा समान हैं, तो k का मान है :
questions.text_english: If the roots of the quadratic equation √3 x² − kx + 2√3 = 0 are real and equal, then the value(s) of k is/are :
questions.solution: For real and equal roots, discriminant D = 0. Here a = √3, b = −k, c = 2√3. D = b² − 4ac = k² − 4×√3×2√3 = k² − 4×2×3 = k² − 24 = 0. Therefore k² = 24, giving k = ±√24. Option (A) ±√24 is correct. Options B, C, and D give specific values of k that do not satisfy k² = 24 (0² = 0 ≠ 24; 4² = 16 ≠ 24; (−5)² = 25 ≠ 24).

questions.solution: Assertion (A): At θ = 45°, tan 2θ = tan 90°, which is undefined (as cos 90° = 0). So Assertion A is TRUE. Reason (R): sin 90° = 1 and cos 90° = 0, so sin 90° ≠ cos 90° is TRUE. However, the reason that tan 90° is undefined is because cos 90° = 0 (denominator becomes zero), not because sin 90° ≠ cos 90°. Therefore both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A. Answer is (B).

Reason (R): Radius is perpendicular to the tangent.

questions.solution: Assertion (A): The shortest distance from the centre to the tangent is the perpendicular distance, which equals the radius. So A is TRUE. Reason (R): The radius drawn to the point of tangency is perpendicular to the tangent. So R is TRUE. Moreover, R correctly explains A — the perpendicularity of the radius to the tangent is precisely why the radius is the shortest distance from the centre to the tangent line. Therefore both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A. Answer is (A).

questions.text: 7 cm त्रिज्या वाले अर्धगोले पर एक शंकु को अध्यारोपित करके एक खिलौना बनाया गया है । खिलौने की कुल ऊँचाई 31 cm है । खिलौने का सम्पूर्ण पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए ।
questions.text_english: A toy is in the form of a cone mounted on a hemisphere of radius 7 cm. The total height of the toy is 31 cm. Find the total surface area of the toy.

key_points: Height of cone = total height − radius of hemisphere = 31 − 7 = 24 cm
Slant height of cone l = √(r² + h²) = √(49 + 576) = √625 = 25 cm
TSA = curved surface area of cone + curved surface area of hemisphere = πrl + 2πr²

questions.image_description: A toy formed by a cone mounted on a hemisphere. The hemisphere has radius 7 cm and the total height of the toy is 31 cm.
questions.solution: The radius of the hemisphere (and base of cone) r = 7 cm. Height of the cone h = total height − radius of hemisphere = 31 − 7 = 24 cm. Slant height of cone l = √(r² + h²) = √(7² + 24²) = √(49 + 576) = √625 = 25 cm. Total surface area = curved surface area of cone + curved surface area of hemisphere = πrl + 2πr² = π × 7 × 25 + 2 × π × 7² = 175π + 98π = 273π = 273 × 22/7 = 858 cm².

questions.text: दी गई आकृति में △ ABE ≅ △ ACD है । सिद्ध कीजिए कि △ ADE ~ △ ABC है ।
questions.text_english: In the given figure, △ ABE ≅ △ ACD. Prove that △ ADE ~ △ ABC.

key_points: From △ ABE ≅ △ ACD, conclude AB = AC and AD = AE (CPCT)
Show AD/AB = AE/AC
Use ∠A = ∠A (common) and SAS similarity to prove △ ADE ~ △ ABC

questions.image_description: Triangle ABC with D on AB and E on AC. Lines BE and CD intersect inside the triangle. Triangle ABE is congruent to triangle ACD.
questions.solution: Since △ ABE ≅ △ ACD (given), by CPCT: AB = AC and AE = AD. Therefore AD/AB = AE/AC (since AD = AE and AB = AC means the ratios are equal). Also, ∠DAE = ∠BAC (common angle). By SAS similarity criterion, △ ADE ~ △ ABC. Hence proved.

questions.text:
(क) एक समांतर श्रेढ़ी (A.P.) का प्रथम पद 4 तथा अन्तिम पद 31 है । यदि सभी पदों का योगफल 175 है, तो पदों की संख्या तथा सार्व अन्तर ज्ञात कीजिए ।

अथवा

(ख) समांतर श्रेढ़ी (A.P.) 21, 18, 15, ... के कितने पदों का योगफल शून्य होगा ?
questions.text_english:
(a) In an A.P., the first term is 4 and the last term is 31. If sum of all the terms is 175, find the number of terms and the common difference.

OR

(b) How many terms of the A.P. 21, 18, 15, .... must be added to get the sum zero ?
questions.solution:
Part (a): Given a = 4, l = 31, Sn = 175. Using the formula Sn = n/2 × (a + l): 175 = n/2 × (4 + 31) = 35n/2. So n = 175 × 2/35 = 10. The common difference d = (l − a)/(n − 1) = (31 − 4)/(10 − 1) = 27/9 = 3. Therefore, number of terms = 10 and common difference = 3.

Part (b): For AP 21, 18, 15, ..., a = 21 and d = −3. Setting Sn = 0: n/2 × [2×21 + (n−1)(−3)] = 0. So 42 − 3(n−1) = 0 → 42 − 3n + 3 = 0 → 45 = 3n → n = 15. Therefore 15 terms must be added to get sum zero.

questions.text: लकड़ी के उस पट्टे (Plank) की लम्बाई बताइए जिसकी सहायता से 4 m 20 cm तथा 5 m 4 cm लम्बाई को न्यूनतम समय में पूरा-पूरा नापा जा सके ।
questions.text_english: Find the length of the plank that can be used to measure the lengths 4 m 20 cm and 5 m 4 cm exactly, in the least time.

key_points: Convert: 4 m 20 cm = 420 cm, 5 m 4 cm = 504 cm
Required length = HCF(420, 504)

questions.solution: To measure two lengths exactly in the least number of times, the plank length must be the HCF of the two measurements. Converting: 4 m 20 cm = 420 cm and 5 m 4 cm = 504 cm. Finding HCF by prime factorisation: 420 = 2² × 3 × 5 × 7 and 504 = 2³ × 3² × 7. HCF = 2² × 3 × 7 = 4 × 3 × 7 = 84 cm. The required plank length is 84 cm.

questions.text:
(क) वर्ग ABCD के विकर्ण AC तथा BD बिंदु P पर प्रतिच्छेद करते हैं । बिंदु B तथा D के निर्देशांक क्रमशः (9, −2) तथा (1, 6) हैं ।
(i) बिंदु P के निर्देशांक ज्ञात कीजिए ।
(ii) वर्ग की भुजा की लम्बाई ज्ञात कीजिए ।

अथवा

(ख) रेखा x + y = 5 पर स्थित उस बिंदु के निर्देशांक बताइए जो (6, 4) तथा (5, 2) से समदूरस्थ हो ।
questions.text_english:
(a) Diagonals AC and BD of square ABCD intersect at P. Coordinates of points B and D are (9, −2) and (1, 6) respectively.
(i) Find the co-ordinates of point P.
(ii) Find the length of the side of the square.

OR

(b) Find the coordinates of a point on the line x + y = 5 which is equidistant from (6, 4) and (5, 2).

key_points: (a)(i) P is the midpoint of BD: P = ((9+1)/2, (−2+6)/2) = (5, 2)
(b) Let point be (x, 5−x); equidistant from (6,4) and (5,2) gives x = 2, point = (2,3)

questions.image_description: Square ABCD with diagonals AC and BD intersecting at P. B is at (9, −2) and D is at (1, 6).
questions.solution:
Part (a): In a square, diagonals bisect each other. So P is the midpoint of BD. P = ((9+1)/2, (−2+6)/2) = (10/2, 4/2) = (5, 2). For part (ii): BD = √((9−1)² + (−2−6)²) = √(8² + 8²) = √128 = 8√2 cm. In a square, diagonal = side × √2, so side = BD/√2 = 8√2/√2 = 8 units.

Part (b): Let the point be (x, 5−x) on x + y = 5. Distance from (6,4): √((x−6)² + (5−x−4)²) = √((x−6)² + (1−x)²). Distance from (5,2): √((x−5)² + (5−x−2)²) = √((x−5)² + (3−x)²). Setting them equal and squaring: (x−6)² + (1−x)² = (x−5)² + (3−x)². Expanding: x²−12x+36 + 1−2x+x² = x²−10x+25 + 9−6x+x². So −14x+37 = −16x+34, giving 2x = −3, x = −3/2... Rechecking: 2x = 34−37 = −3, x = −3/2. Then y = 5−(−3/2) = 13/2. The point is (−3/2, 13/2).

questions.text: सिद्ध कीजिए कि √2 एक अपरिमेय संख्या है ।
questions.text_english: Prove that √2 is an irrational number.

key_points: Assume √2 is rational, so √2 = p/q where p and q are co-prime integers and q ≠ 0
Squaring: 2 = p²/q², so p² = 2q², meaning 2 divides p²
Since 2 is prime and divides p², 2 divides p; write p = 2m, then 4m² = 2q², so q² = 2m², meaning 2 divides q — contradiction to p and q being co-prime

questions.solution: Assume, for contradiction, that √2 is rational. Then √2 = p/q, where p and q are integers with no common factor (i.e., co-prime) and q ≠ 0. Squaring both sides: 2 = p²/q², so p² = 2q². This means 2 divides p². Since 2 is a prime number and it divides p², it must divide p as well. So let p = 2m for some integer m. Substituting: (2m)² = 2q² → 4m² = 2q² → q² = 2m². This means 2 divides q², and hence 2 divides q. But if 2 divides both p and q, then p and q have a common factor of 2, which contradicts our assumption that p and q are co-prime. Therefore, our assumption is wrong and √2 is irrational.

questions.text:
(क) बाह्य बिंदु P से, O केन्द्र वाले वृत्त पर स्पर्श रेखाएँ PA तथा PB खींची गई हैं । सिद्ध कीजिए कि ∠APB = 2∠OAB है ।

अथवा

(ख) दी गई आकृति में, PA, O केन्द्र वाले वृत्त पर खींची गई ऐसी स्पर्श रेखा है कि OA = 10 cm, AB = 8 cm तथा AB ⊥ OP है । PB की लम्बाई ज्ञात कीजिए ।
questions.text_english:
(a) Two tangents PA and PB are drawn to a circle with centre O from an external point P. Prove that ∠APB = 2∠OAB.

OR

(b) In the given figure, PA is the tangent to the circle with centre O such that OA = 10 cm, AB = 8 cm and AB ⊥ OP. Find the length of PB.

key_points: (a) Let ∠APB = 2θ; tangents from external point are equal so triangle PAB is isosceles
(a) ∠OAP = 90° (radius ⊥ tangent); ∠OAB = 90° − ∠PAB = 90° − (90°−θ) = θ = ∠APB/2
(b) OB = √(OA² − AB²) = 6 cm (since AB ⊥ OP means B is foot of perpendicular from O to PA); OP = √(OA² + AP²) using tangent; PA² = OP² − OA²; PB = PA − AB

questions.image_description: For part (b): Circle with centre O. Point P outside. PA is tangent touching at A. B is the foot of perpendicular from O to PA (AB ⊥ OP). OA = 10 cm, AB = 8 cm.
questions.solution:
Part (a): Since PA = PB (tangents from external point), triangle PAB is isosceles. Let ∠APB = 2θ, then ∠PAB = ∠PBA = (180° − 2θ)/2 = 90° − θ. Since OA ⊥ PA (radius perpendicular to tangent), ∠OAP = 90°. Therefore ∠OAB = ∠OAP − ∠PAB... wait: ∠OAB = 90° − ∠PAB = 90° − (90° − θ) = θ = ∠APB/2. Hence ∠APB = 2∠OAB. Proved.

Part (b): OA = 10 cm, AB = 8 cm, AB ⊥ OP. In right triangle OAB (right angle at B since AB ⊥ OP and B lies on PA): OB² = OA² − AB² = 100 − 64 = 36, so OB = 6 cm. Since OA ⊥ PA (tangent), in right triangle OAP: OP² = OA² + AP²... but B is on PA. Actually AB ⊥ OP means angle ABP = 90°. In right triangle ABP, PB² = AP² − AB²... we need AP. In triangle OAP (right angle at A): OP² = OA² + PA². Also in triangle OBP (right angle at B): OP² = OB² + BP²... OB = 6. From triangle OAB: angle at B = 90°, OB = 6, AB = 8, OA = 10 ✓. OP: B is on PA, BP = PA − AB. PA² = OP² − OA² and OP² = OB² + PB² (right angle at B). Let PB = x. Then OP² = 36 + x². Also PA = PB + BA = x + 8 (if B between P and A). PA² = OP² − 100 = 36 + x² − 100 = x² − 64. But PA = x + 8, so (x+8)² = x² − 64 → x² + 16x + 64 = x² − 64 → 16x = −128 → x = −8. This is negative, so B is not between P and A. Try PB = AB + AP... reconsider: B lies on OP (foot of perpendicular from O to PA). Actually AB ⊥ OP means OB ⊥ PA (B on PA). So in right △OBP: OP² = OB² + BP². OB = 6, BP = x. In right △OAP (∠A=90°): OP² = OA² + AP² = 100 + AP². Also AP = AB + BP = 8 + x. So 36 + x² = 100 + (8+x)² = 100 + 64 + 16x + x² → 36 = 164 + 16x → 16x = −128. Still negative — meaning B is between A and P, so AP = AB − BP if B between A and P... AP = 8 − x. Then 36 + x² = 100 + (8−x)² = 100 + 64 − 16x + x² → 36 = 164 − 16x → 16x = 128 → x = 8. Therefore PB = 8 cm.

questions.text: बिंदुओं (1, 3) तथा (2, 5) को जोड़ने वाले रेखाखण्ड को रेखा 3x + y − 9 = 0 एक निश्चित अनुपात में विभाजित करती है । वह अनुपात तथा प्रतिच्छेदी बिंदु के निर्देशांक ज्ञात कीजिए ।
questions.text_english: Determine the ratio in which the line 3x + y − 9 = 0 divides the line segment joining the points (1, 3) and (2, 5). Find the point of intersection.

key_points: Let the line divide the segment in ratio k:1 at point P
P = ((2k+1)/(k+1), (5k+3)/(k+1)) using section formula
Substituting in 3x+y=9 gives k = 3/2, ratio = 3:2; point P = (8/5, 21/5)

questions.solution: Let the line 3x + y − 9 = 0 divide the segment joining (1, 3) and (2, 5) in the ratio k : 1. By section formula, the dividing point is P = ((2k+1)/(k+1), (5k+3)/(k+1)). Since P lies on 3x + y − 9 = 0: 3×(2k+1)/(k+1) + (5k+3)/(k+1) − 9 = 0. Multiplying through by (k+1): 3(2k+1) + (5k+3) − 9(k+1) = 0 → 6k+3 + 5k+3 − 9k−9 = 0 → 2k − 3 = 0 → k = 3/2. The ratio is 3:2. The point of intersection: x = (2×(3/2)+1)/((3/2)+1) = (3+1)/(5/2) = 4×2/5 = 8/5. y = (5×(3/2)+3)/((3/2)+1) = (15/2+3)/(5/2) = (21/2)/(5/2) = 21/5. The point is (8/5, 21/5).

questions.text:
(क) यदि sin θ + cos θ = √3 है, तो सिद्ध कीजिए कि tan θ + cot θ = 1 है ।

अथवा

(ख) सिद्ध कीजिए :
(sin A + sec A)² + (cos A + cosec A)² = (1 + sec A cosec A)²
questions.text_english:
(a) If sin θ + cos θ = √3, then prove that tan θ + cot θ = 1.

OR

(b) Prove that :
(sin A + sec A)² + (cos A + cosec A)² = (1 + sec A cosec A)²

key_points: (a) Square both sides: sin²θ + cos²θ + 2sinθcosθ = 3 → 1 + 2sinθcosθ = 3 → sinθcosθ = 1
(a) tan θ + cot θ = sinθ/cosθ + cosθ/sinθ = (sin²θ + cos²θ)/(sinθcosθ) = 1/1 = 1
(b) Expand LHS and show it equals RHS using sin²A + cos²A = 1

questions.solution:
Part (a): Given sin θ + cos θ = √3. Squaring both sides: sin²θ + 2 sin θ cos θ + cos²θ = 3. Since sin²θ + cos²θ = 1: 1 + 2 sin θ cos θ = 3 → sin θ cos θ = 1. Now, tan θ + cot θ = sin θ/cos θ + cos θ/sin θ = (sin²θ + cos²θ)/(sin θ cos θ) = 1/1 = 1. Hence proved.

Part (b): LHS = (sin A + sec A)² + (cos A + cosec A)². Expanding: sin²A + 2 sin A sec A + sec²A + cos²A + 2 cos A cosec A + cosec²A = (sin²A + cos²A) + 2 sin A/cos A + 2 cos A/sin A + sec²A + cosec²A = 1 + 2(sin²A + cos²A)/(sin A cos A) + sec²A + cosec²A = 1 + 2/(sin A cos A) + sec²A + cosec²A. RHS = (1 + sec A cosec A)² = 1 + 2 sec A cosec A + sec²A cosec²A = 1 + 2/(sin A cos A) + 1/(sin²A cos²A). Both sides equal, hence proved.

questions.text: दी गई आकृति में, 7 cm त्रिज्या वाले वृत्त के केन्द्र पर जीवा AB 120° का कोण अंतरित करती है । ज्ञात कीजिए (i) दीर्घ त्रिज्यखंड OACB का परिमाप, और (ii) छायांकित भाग का क्षेत्रफल, यदि △ OAB का क्षेत्रफल 21.2 cm² है ।
questions.text_english: In the given figure, chord AB subtends an angle of 120° at the centre of the circle with radius 7 cm. Find (i) perimeter of major sector OACB, and (ii) area of the shaded segment, if area of △ OAB = 21.2 cm².

key_points: Major sector angle = 360° − 120° = 240°
Area of minor segment = Area of minor sector − Area of △OAB = (120/360)×π×7² − 21.2

questions.image_description: Circle with centre O and radius 7 cm. Chord AB subtends angle AOB = 120° at centre. Minor segment (shaded) below chord AB. Major sector OACB is the larger region.
questions.solution:
Given: radius r = 7 cm, angle AOB = 120°, area of △OAB = 21.2 cm².

(i) The major sector OACB has angle = 360° − 120° = 240°. Perimeter of major sector OACB = OA + OB + arc ACB = 7 + 7 + (240/360) × 2π × 7 = 14 + (2/3) × 2 × (22/7) × 7 = 14 + (2/3) × 44 = 14 + 88/3 = 42/3 + 88/3 = 130/3 ≈ 43.3 cm.

(ii) Area of minor sector = (120/360) × π × 7² = (1/3) × (22/7) × 49 = (1/3) × 154 = 154/3 cm². Area of shaded (minor) segment = Area of minor sector − Area of △OAB = 154/3 − 21.2 = 51.33 − 21.2 = 30.13 cm².

questions.text: दो ऐसे क्रमागत ऋणात्मक पूर्णांक ज्ञात कीजिए जिनके वर्गों का योगफल 481 है ।
questions.text_english: Find two consecutive negative integers, sum of whose squares is 481.

key_points: Let the integers be x and x+1 (consecutive negative)
x = (−1 ± √961)/2 = (−1 ± 31)/2; taking negative root: x = −16, other integer = −15

questions.solution: Let the two consecutive negative integers be x and x + 1. Given x² + (x+1)² = 481. Expanding: x² + x² + 2x + 1 = 481 → 2x² + 2x − 480 = 0 → x² + x − 240 = 0. Using the quadratic formula: x = (−1 ± √(1 + 960))/2 = (−1 ± √961)/2 = (−1 ± 31)/2. Taking the negative root: x = (−1 − 31)/2 = −32/2 = −16. The other integer = −16 + 1 = −15. Verification: (−16)² + (−15)² = 256 + 225 = 481 ✓. The two consecutive negative integers are −16 and −15.

questions.text:
(क) निम्नलिखित रैखिक समीकरण युग्म को ग्राफीय विधि से हल कीजिए :
x − 2y = 3,  3x − 8y = 7

अथवा

(ख) पाँच वर्ष पहले आदिल की उम्र भरत की उम्र की तीन गुना थी और दस वर्ष पश्चात् आदिल की उम्र भरत की उम्र की दोगुना होगी । आदिल तथा भरत की वर्तमान उम्र जानने के लिए :
(i) उपर्युक्त परिस्थिति के आधार पर रैखिक समीकरण बनाइए ।
(ii) दर्शाइए कि रैखिक समीकरण युग्म संगत है तथा इसका अद्वितीय हल है ।
(iii) आदिल तथा भरत की वर्तमान आयु ज्ञात कीजिए ।

(a) Solve the following system of equations graphically :
x − 2y = 3,  3x − 8y = 7

OR

(b) Five years ago, Adil was thrice as old as Bharat. Ten years later Adil shall be twice as old as Bharat. To know the present ages of Adil and Bharat :
(i) form the linear equations representing the above information.
(ii) show that the system of equations is consistent with unique solution.
(iii) find the present ages of Adil and Bharat.

sub_questions.text: निम्नलिखित रैखिक समीकरण युग्म को ग्राफीय विधि से हल कीजिए : x − 2y = 3,  3x − 8y = 7
sub_questions.text_english: Solve the following system of equations graphically : x − 2y = 3, 3x − 8y = 7

key_points: Plot both lines
Find intersection point
Solution: x = 5, y = 1

sub_questions.solution: For x − 2y = 3: when x=3, y=0; when x=1, y=−1; when x=5, y=1. For 3x − 8y = 7: when x=1, y=−1/2; when x=5, y=1. Plotting both lines on the graph, they intersect at the point (5, 1). Verification: 5 − 2(1) = 3 ✓ and 3(5) − 8(1) = 15 − 8 = 7 ✓. The solution is x = 5, y = 1.

sub_questions.text: (i) रैखिक समीकरण बनाइए। (ii) दर्शाइए कि हल अद्वितीय है। (iii) वर्तमान आयु ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: (i) Form linear equations. (ii) Show unique solution. (iii) Find present ages of Adil and Bharat.

key_points: a1/a2 ≠ b1/b2 (1/1 ≠ −3/−2) so unique solution
Solving: B = 20, A = 50

sub_questions.solution: (i) Let present ages of Adil = A years and Bharat = B years. Five years ago: A − 5 = 3(B − 5) → A − 3B = −10. Ten years later: A + 10 = 2(B + 10) → A − 2B = 10. (ii) For the pair a₁x + b₁y = c₁ and a₂x + b₂y = c₂: coefficients are 1, −3, −10 and 1, −2, 10. a₁/a₂ = 1 ≠ b₁/b₂ = −3/−2 = 3/2, so the lines intersect and the system has a unique solution. (iii) Subtracting the first equation from the second: (A−2B) − (A−3B) = 10−(−10) → B = 20. Substituting: A − 2(20) = 10 → A = 50. Adil's present age = 50 years, Bharat's present age = 20 years.

questions.text:
(क) भूमि पर स्थित बिंदु A से एक भवन के शिखर का उन्नयन कोण 30° है । भवन के आधार की ओर 24 m चलने पर बिंदु B से उन्नयन कोण बदलकर 60° हो जाता है । भवन की ऊँचाई तथा भवन के आधार से बिंदु A की दूरी ज्ञात कीजिए । (√3 = 1.73 लीजिए)

अथवा

(ख) समतल भूमि पर एक मीनार ऊर्ध्वाधर खड़ी है । मीनार के शिखर पर खड़ा एक आदमी अपने मित्र को 30° के अवनमन कोण पर देखता है, जो कि मीनार के पाद की ओर एकसमान चाल से आ रहा है । 30 सेकण्ड बाद यह कोण 60° का हो गया । इस बिंदु से मीनार के पाद तक पहुँचने में मित्र द्वारा लिया गया समय ज्ञात कीजिए ।
questions.text_english:
(a) The angle of elevation of the top of a building from a point A, on the ground, is 30°. On moving a distance of 24 m towards its base to the point B, the angle of elevation changes to 60°. Find the height of the building and distance of point A from the base of the building. (Take √3 = 1.73)

OR

(b) A tower stands vertically on the ground. A man standing at the top of the tower observes his friend at an angle of depression of 30°, who is approaching the foot of the tower with a uniform speed. 30 seconds later, the angle of depression changes to 60°. Find the time taken by his friend to reach the foot of the tower from this point.

key_points: (a) Let height = h, distance from A to base = d; tan30° = h/d → d = h√3; tan60° = h/(d−24) → d−24 = h/√3
(b) Let height = h; at first position dist = h√3, at second dist = h/√3; friend covers h√3 − h/√3 = 2h/√3 in 30s; remaining dist = h/√3; time = 15 s

questions.solution:
Part (a): Let the height of the building be h metres and the distance of B from the base be x. From B: tan 60° = h/x → x = h/√3. From A (24 m from B): tan 30° = h/(x+24) → x+24 = h√3 → h/√3 + 24 = h√3 → 24 = h√3 − h/√3 = h(3−1)/√3 = 2h/√3. Therefore h = 24√3/2 = 12√3 = 12 × 1.73 = 20.76 m. Distance of A from base = x + 24 = h/√3 + 24 = 12 + 24 = 36 m.

Part (b): Let tower height = h. When angle of depression = 30°, friend is at distance d₁ = h tan 60°... using alternate angles: h/d₁ = tan 30° → d₁ = h√3. After 30 seconds, h/d₂ = tan 60° → d₂ = h/√3. Distance covered in 30 s = h√3 − h/√3 = 2h/√3. Speed = 2h/(30√3). Remaining distance = h/√3. Time = (h/√3) ÷ (2h/30√3) = (h/√3) × (30√3/2h) = 30/2 = 15 seconds.

questions.text: बिंदु X, △ ABC की माध्यिका AD पर स्थित ऐसा बिंदु है कि AX : XD = 2 : 3 है । BX को बढ़ाने पर यह भुजा AC को बिंदु Y पर प्रतिच्छेद करती है । सिद्ध कीजिए कि BX = 4 XY है ।
questions.text_english: In △ ABC, AD is a median. X is a point on AD such that AX : XD = 2 : 3. BX is extended so that it intersects AC at Y. Prove that BX = 4 XY.

key_points: Draw DM parallel to BY meeting AC at M; use midpoint theorem
In triangle ADM, X divides AD in 2:3 and XY || DM → AY:YM = AX:XD = 2:3 by basic proportionality theorem... then use D midpoint of BC
BX/XY = 4 using similar triangles or vector method

questions.image_description: Triangle ABC with median AD (D is midpoint of BC). Point X on AD with AX:XD = 2:3. Line BX extended meets AC at Y.
questions.solution: Draw a line through D parallel to BX (and BY), meeting AC at M. In triangle ABM, since D is the midpoint of BC... wait, D is midpoint of BC. Consider triangle AXY and triangle DXM (from the parallel line through D). Since DM || XY (DM || BY by construction), in triangle ABY: D is midpoint of... Let us use the correct approach. Draw DM || BY where M is on AC. In triangle BCY (extended), DM || BY and D is midpoint of BC, so by midpoint theorem, M is the midpoint of CY, i.e., CM = MY. In triangle ADM, X is on AD with AX:XD = 2:3. XY || DM (since both are parallel to BY). By Basic Proportionality Theorem in triangle ADM: AX/XD = AY/YM = 2/3. So AY:YM = 2:3. Since CM = MY, and AY + YM + MC = AC... Actually AY/YM = 2/3 where M is midpoint of YC. Then AY/YC = AY/(YM+MC) = AY/(YM+YM) = AY/(2YM) = (2/3 × YM)/(2YM) = 1/3. So AY:YC = 1:3, meaning Y divides AC in ratio 1:3. Now in triangles BXD and YXA (using the parallels): BX/XY = BX/XY. In triangles BXD and YXA: ∠BXD = ∠YXA (vertically opposite), BD || ...using the ratios: BX/XY = XD/XA × BD/AY = (3/2) × BD/AY. BD = DC (D midpoint), and AY/AC = 1/4 (from AY:YC = 1:3). Using similar triangles BXD ~ YXA: BX/YX = XD/XA = 3/2... but we need 4. Let me use vectors. Let A be origin, vectors AB = b, AC = c. D = (b+c)/2 (midpoint of BC). X divides AD in 2:3: AX = (2/5)AD = (2/5)(b+c)/2 = (b+c)/5. Line BX: points B = b and X = (b+c)/5. Parametric: b + t((b+c)/5 − b) = b + t(c−4b)/5. For Y on AC: Y = sc for some s. So b + t(c−4b)/5 = sc → b(1 − 4t/5) + c(t/5) = sc. For this to lie on AC, coefficient of b = 0: 1 − 4t/5 = 0 → t = 5/4. Then s = t/5 = 1/4. So AY = (1/4)AC, meaning Y divides AC such that AY:AC = 1:4. Now BX corresponds to t = 5/4 and XY is from X (at t=1 since X is on BX with t=1) ... the parameter for X is t = 1 (X is the point itself). Since Y is at t = 5/4 from B, and X is at t = 1, the parameter difference from X to Y is 5/4 − 1 = 1/4. The full BX distance corresponds to t from 0 to 1 and BY corresponds to 0 to 5/4. So BX/BY = 1/(5/4) = 4/5. Therefore BX = (4/5)BY, which means XY = BY − BX = (1/5)BY. So BX/XY = (4/5)BY / (1/5)BY = 4. Hence BX = 4XY. Proved.

questions.text:
मेज पर रखने के लिए 'लीफी बॉल फाउन्टेन' का एक मॉडल बनाया गया । पानी सहजता से गेंद की सतह से बहता हुआ एक सुसज्जित बेलनाकार टंकी में जाता है जहाँ से पुन: वापस आता है ।

गोलाकार गेंद का व्यास 21 cm है ।

बेलनाकार टंकी – बाह्य व्यास 50 cm है तथा आंतरिक व्यास 40 cm है ।

ठोस आधार की ऊँचाई 14 cm है ।

भरे हुए पानी की ऊँचाई 7 cm है ।

उपर्युक्त आकृति के आधार पर निम्नलिखित प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिए :
(i) फव्वारे की कुल ऊँचाई ज्ञात कीजिए ।
(ii) गेंद का आयतन ज्ञात कीजिए ।
(iii) (क) यदि गेंद का एक-तिहाई हिस्सा पानी में डूबा हो, तो टंकी में पानी का आयतन ज्ञात कीजिए ।

अथवा

(iii) (ख) बेलनाकार भाग का बाह्य वक्र पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल तथा गेंद के पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल का योगफल ज्ञात कीजिए ।
questions.text_english:
A model of Leafy Ball Fountain is made to be kept on the tabletop. Water gently cascades down the ball into a decorative cylindrical pool where it is recycled.

The diameter of spherical ball is 21 cm.

Cylindrical pool – Outer diameter is 50 cm and inner diameter is 40 cm.

Height of solid base is 14 cm.

Height of water filled is 7 cm.

Observe the figure and answer the following questions :
(i) Determine the total height of the fountain.
(ii) Find the volume of the ball.
(iii) (a) If one-third of the ball is submerged in the water, find the volume of the water filled in the pool.

OR

(iii) (b) Find the sum of the outer curved surface area of the cylindrical part and surface area of the ball.

sub_questions.text: फव्वारे की कुल ऊँचाई ज्ञात कीजिए ।
sub_questions.text_english: Determine the total height of the fountain.

key_points: Total height = height of solid base + height of water + diameter of ball = 14 + 7 + 21 = 42 cm

sub_questions.solution: The total height of the fountain consists of the solid base (14 cm), the water level (7 cm), and the ball resting on top (diameter = 21 cm). Total height = 14 + 7 + 21 = 42 cm.

sub_questions.text_english: Find the volume of the ball.

sub_questions.text: यदि गेंद का एक-तिहाई हिस्सा पानी में डूबा हो, तो टंकी में पानी का आयतन ज्ञात कीजिए ।
sub_questions.text_english: If one-third of the ball is submerged in the water, find the volume of the water filled in the pool.

key_points: Volume of cylindrical annular region of water = π(R² − r²)h where R=25cm, r=20cm, h=7cm
Subtract (1/3) of ball volume submerged

sub_questions.solution: Outer radius R = 25 cm, inner radius r = 20 cm, height of water h = 7 cm. Volume of annular cylindrical space = π(R² − r²) × h = (22/7)(625 − 400) × 7 = 22 × 225 = 4950 cm³. Volume of ball submerged = (1/3) × 4851 = 1617 cm³. Volume of water in pool = 4950 − 1617 = 3333 cm³.

sub_questions.text: बेलनाकार भाग का बाह्य वक्र पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल तथा गेंद के पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल का योगफल ज्ञात कीजिए ।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the sum of the outer curved surface area of the cylindrical part and surface area of the ball.

key_points: Surface area of sphere = 4πr² = 4×(22/7)×(10.5)² = 1386 cm²

sub_questions.solution: The total height of the cylindrical pool = solid base + water height = 14 + 7 = 21 cm. Outer radius R = 25 cm. Outer curved surface area of cylinder = 2πRh = 2 × (22/7) × 25 × 21 = 2 × 22 × 25 × 3 = 3300 cm². Surface area of ball = 4πr² = 4 × (22/7) × (10.5)² = 4 × (22/7) × 110.25 = (4 × 22 × 110.25)/7 = 9702/7 = 1386 cm². Total = 3300 + 1386 = 4686 cm².

questions.text:
रंगमंच के नाटक के दौरान, मंच की पृष्ठभूमि के लिए भवन मेहराब (arches) का प्रयोग किया गया । नीचे दिखाई गई एक मेहराब (arch) के वक्र को बहुपद p(x) = – x² + 2x + 8 के द्वारा निरूपित किया जा सकता है । यहाँ x मंच की सतह पर लम्बाई (फुट में) को दर्शाता है ।

उपर्युक्त आकृति के आधार पर निम्नलिखित प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिए ।
(i) मेहराब की ऊँचाई ज्ञात कीजिए ।
(ii) (क) बहुपद p(x) के शून्यक ज्ञात कीजिए । उपर्युक्त ग्राफ में कौन-से बिंदु शून्यक को दर्शाते हैं ?

अथवा

(ii) (ख) मंच की सतह पर मेहराब का विस्तार (span) ज्ञात कीजिए ।
(iii) उपर्युक्त वक्र तथा y-अक्ष के प्रतिच्छेदी बिंदु के निर्देशांक लिखिए ।
questions.text_english:
During a theatre drama, a backdrop of building arches was used. The shape of the curve shown below can be represented by the polynomial p(x) = – x² + 2x + 8, where x is the length (in feet) on stage level.

Based on the figure given above, answer the following questions :
(i) Determine the height of the arch.
(ii) (a) Find zeroes of the polynomial p(x). Which points on the graph represent the zeroes ?

OR

(ii) (b) Find the span of the arch on the stage floor.
(iii) Write the coordinates of the point of intersection of the above curve with the y-axis.

sub_questions.text_english: Determine the height of the arch.

key_points: Maximum of p(x) = −x²+2x+8 at vertex x=1: p(1) = −1+2+8 = 9 feet

sub_questions.solution: The height of the arch is the maximum value of p(x) = −x² + 2x + 8. At the vertex x = −b/(2a) = −2/(2×(−1)) = 1. p(1) = −1 + 2 + 8 = 9 feet. The height of the arch is 9 feet. From the graph, point C(1, y) confirms this as C(1, 9).

sub_questions.text: बहुपद p(x) के शून्यक ज्ञात कीजिए । ग्राफ में कौन-से बिंदु शून्यक को दर्शाते हैं ?
sub_questions.text_english: Find zeroes of the polynomial p(x). Which points on the graph represent the zeroes ?

key_points: Points A(4, 0) and B(−2, 0) represent the zeroes on the graph

sub_questions.solution: Setting p(x) = 0: −x² + 2x + 8 = 0 → x² − 2x − 8 = 0 → (x − 4)(x + 2) = 0. So x = 4 or x = −2. The zeroes are x = 4 and x = −2. On the graph, point A(4, 0) and point B(−2, 0) represent the zeroes — these are the points where the curve meets the x-axis (stage floor).

sub_questions.text: मंच की सतह पर मेहराब का विस्तार (span) ज्ञात कीजिए ।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the span of the arch on the stage floor.

key_points: Zeroes at x = 4 and x = −2; span = 4 − (−2) = 6 feet

sub_questions.solution: The arch meets the stage floor (x-axis) at x = 4 and x = −2 (the zeroes of p(x)). The span is the distance between these two points = 4 − (−2) = 6 feet.

sub_questions.text: उपर्युक्त वक्र तथा y-अक्ष के प्रतिच्छेदी बिंदु के निर्देशांक लिखिए ।
sub_questions.text_english: Write the coordinates of the point of intersection of the above curve with the y-axis.
sub_questions.solution: The curve intersects the y-axis where x = 0. p(0) = −(0)² + 2(0) + 8 = 8. The coordinates of the point of intersection with the y-axis are (0, 8).

questions.text:
कुछ दोस्त ताश की दो एकसमान गड्डियों को लेकर उनसे ताश खेलना चाहते थे । ताश के पत्तों को फेंटते समय तीन पत्ते नीचे गिर गए । उन्होंने शेष पत्तों को अच्छी प्रकार फेंटकर यादृच्छया एक पत्ता निकाला । यह मानते हुए कि गिरे हुए तीन पत्तों में एक पान की बेगम, एक हुकुम का दस तथा एक चिड़ी का इक्का है, निम्नलिखित प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिए :
(i) इसकी क्या प्रायिकता है कि निकाला गया पत्ता एक फेस कार्ड (face card) है ?
(ii) प्रायिकता ज्ञात कीजिए कि निकाला गया पत्ता बेगम या बादशाह है ।
(iii) (क) क्या आपको लगता है कि यदि कोई पत्ता नहीं गिरता, तो निकाले गए पत्ते के बेगम होने की प्रायिकता ज्यादा होती ? तर्क सहित उत्तर दीजिए ।

अथवा

(iii) (ख) प्रायिकता ज्ञात कीजिए कि निकाला गया पत्ता गुलाम है । इसकी तुलना उस स्थिति में निकाली गई प्रायिकता से कीजिए यदि कोई पत्ता नहीं गिरता । किस परिस्थिति में निकाले गए पत्ते के गुलाम होने की प्रायिकता अधिक है ?
questions.text_english:
A group of friends wanted to play cards with two identical packs together. While shuffling the cards, three cards are dropped. Rest of the cards are shuffled and one card is drawn at random. Assuming that the dropped cards were a queen of hearts, a ten of spades and an ace of clubs, answer the following questions :
(i) Find the probability that the drawn card is a face card.
(ii) Find the probability that the drawn card is either a king or a queen.
(iii) (a) Do you think that the probability of getting a queen was higher if none of the cards were dropped ? Justify your answer.

OR

(iii) (b) Find the probability that the drawn card is a jack. Compare it with the probability when none of the cards were dropped. In which case is the probability of getting a jack higher ?

sub_questions.text: इसकी क्या प्रायिकता है कि निकाला गया पत्ता एक फेस कार्ड (face card) है ?
sub_questions.text_english: Find the probability that the drawn card is a face card.

key_points: Two packs = 104 cards; 3 dropped = 101 remaining. Face cards in 2 packs = 24 (Jack, Queen, King × 4 suits × 2 packs). One queen dropped, so face cards remaining = 23. P = 23/101

sub_questions.solution: Two identical packs have 104 cards in total. Three cards dropped, so 101 cards remain. Face cards in 2 packs = 3 (Jack, Queen, King) × 4 suits × 2 = 24. One queen of hearts is dropped, so face cards remaining = 24 − 1 = 23. P(face card) = 23/101.

sub_questions.text: प्रायिकता ज्ञात कीजिए कि निकाला गया पत्ता बेगम या बादशाह है ।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the probability that the drawn card is either a king or a queen.

key_points: Kings in 2 packs = 8; Queens in 2 packs = 8; one queen dropped → queens remaining = 7; total kings+queens = 8+7 = 15; P = 15/101

sub_questions.solution: In 2 packs: kings = 8, queens = 8. One queen (of hearts) dropped. Remaining queens = 7, kings = 8. P(king or queen) = (8 + 7)/101 = 15/101.

sub_questions.text: क्या यदि कोई पत्ता नहीं गिरता, तो बेगम होने की प्रायिकता ज्यादा होती ? तर्क सहित उत्तर दीजिए ।
sub_questions.text_english: Do you think that the probability of getting a queen was higher if none of the cards were dropped ? Justify your answer.

key_points: With no cards dropped: P(queen) = 8/104 = 2/26 = 1/13 ≈ 0.0769
With 3 cards dropped (1 queen): P(queen) = 7/101 ≈ 0.0693
1/13 > 7/101, so yes, the probability was higher when no cards were dropped

sub_questions.solution: When no cards are dropped, P(queen) = 8/104 = 1/13 ≈ 0.0769. When 3 cards are dropped (including one queen), P(queen) = 7/101 ≈ 0.0693. Since 1/13 > 7/101 (as 101 > 13×7 = 91, so 101/7 > 13, meaning 1/13 > 7/101 ✓), yes, the probability of getting a queen was higher when no cards were dropped. The dropped queen reduced both the number of favourable outcomes and the total, but the proportional reduction in favourable outcomes was greater.

sub_questions.text: प्रायिकता ज्ञात कीजिए कि निकाला गया पत्ता गुलाम है और दोनों स्थितियों की तुलना कीजिए ।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the probability that the drawn card is a jack. Compare it with the probability when none of the cards were dropped. In which case is the probability of getting a jack higher ?

key_points: Jacks in 2 packs = 8; none dropped; P(jack with drops) = 8/101
P(jack without drops) = 8/104 = 1/13
8/101 > 8/104 = 1/13, so probability of jack is higher when cards are dropped (since total reduced but jacks unchanged)

sub_questions.solution: Jacks in 2 packs = 8 (none were dropped). P(jack after dropping 3 cards) = 8/101. P(jack when no cards dropped) = 8/104 = 1/13. Comparing: 8/101 vs 8/104. Since 101 < 104, we have 8/101 > 8/104. Therefore, the probability of drawing a jack is higher when the three cards were dropped, because the total number of cards decreased while the number of jacks remained the same.
